Meet your instructor

Hi, I’m Saira Sheikh.

I’m an SGI-certified driving instructor based in Saskatoon, and I teach new drivers the way I wish everyone was taught: calmly, clearly, and without pressure.

Learning to drive can feel like a big step — especially if you’re nervous, new to Canada, or would simply feel more comfortable learning with a woman instructor. My lessons are a friendly place to make mistakes, ask questions, and build skills step by step until the road feels like yours.

I offer Class 5 and Class 4 lessons and the full 6 & 6 course, right here in Saskatoon.

Areas covered

Lessons in Saskatoon

Saira’s Driving School is based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. When you book, just mention your neighbourhood and what you need — she’ll confirm the lesson details with you directly.

Questions

Things new students ask

What is the 6 & 6 course, and do I need it?

It’s SGI’s driver education course for new drivers: 6 hours of classroom learning plus 6 hours of in-car training with a certified instructor. New drivers in Saskatchewan who don’t take driver education through a high school program complete their training with a certified instructor like Saira. Message her and she’ll confirm exactly what you need for your situation.

I’ve never driven before. Is that okay?

Completely — most students start from zero. Your first lessons go at an easy pace in quiet areas, and you only move on when you feel ready. Being nervous is normal; being rushed is not how Saira teaches.

How much do lessons cost?

Rates depend on the lesson type — Class 5, Class 4, or the full 6 & 6 course — and how many lessons you book. Call, WhatsApp, or email for current rates; you’ll always know the full price before you start.

Do you teach Class 4 as well as Class 5?

Yes. Saira offers both Class 5 lessons (the regular car licence) and Class 4 lessons for drivers upgrading for taxi and commercial passenger work, including road-test preparation.

Where do lessons take place?

Lessons run across Saskatoon. When you book, you and Saira will agree on a meeting point and the areas you’ll practise in — including the kinds of roads you’ll face on your road test.

How do I book?

The fastest way is a call or WhatsApp message to (306) 715-6868. You can also email sairasdrivingschool@gmail.com or fill in the booking form below — it prepares your message for you, ready to send.
